captions.help.slots.poweroftiger.symbols.descript: Symbol payouts are shown in the selected currency. Changing the bet amount proportionally adjusts the payout scale accordingly.
All symbols pay on active paylines from left to right on consecutive reels, beginning with the leftmost reel.

The WILD symbol substitutes for all symbols on active paylines.
It can appear on all reels. In the base game, whenever a full screen of the same symbol lands or all 5 active paylines form winning combinations, all wins are multiplied by one of the following multipliers selected at random: x5, x10, x15, or x20.
captions.help.slots.poweroftiger.page1.descriptio:
The RESPIN feature may trigger randomly on any spin. When activated, a random paying symbol is selected. At the beginning of the RESPIN, a multiplier of x5, x10, x15, or x20 is randomly selected and displayed.
The reels then spin and stop displaying only the selected symbol, any Wild symbols, and blank positions.
The reels will respin if additional symbols of the selected type or Wild symbols land. These symbols remain locked in place, and a new respin is awarded.
The RESPIN feature ends when no additional selected symbols land during a respin or when the entire screen is filled with the selected symbol and/or Wild symbols.

At the end of the RESPIN, if the screen is fully filled with the selected symbol, all wins are multiplied by the multiplier selected at the beginning of the RESPIN.
Respin winnings are awarded to the player after the round is completed.
captions.help.slots.poweroftiger.page2.descriptio: The game has 5 fixed active paylines.
All symbols pay from left to right on adjacent reels starting from the leftmost reel and only on active paylines. Line wins are multiplied by the bet value on the winning line.
Only the highest win per payline is paid. When winning on multiple paylines, all wins are added together to determine the total win.

captions.help.slots.poweroftiger.otherrules.descr: In the event of a disconnection during gameplay, all accepted bets will still be played out, and any resulting wins will be credited to the player's balance at the end of the round. Please note that after a disconnection, autoplay mode will be switched off to ensure a fair and enjoyable gaming experience. It is important to note that any malfunction will void all plays and payouts, and any unfinished round will be terminated.
If you are playing in autoplay mode, all wins are automatically transferred to your balance.
